claim: The Journey tab's selection predicate never matches the route "journey", so no tab is highlighted while on the Journey screen.
fix: Add currentRoute == "journey" to the match or replace prefix tests with a route-to-tab map.

claim: In Reading mode a tap on a tiered verse opens depth while a tap elsewhere selects, and annotation is unavailable, so the gesture grammar differs verse to verse.
fix: Unify on tap-to-select with a verse action bar and give the ✦ glyph its own tap target for depth.

claim: Reading-mode selection is never rendered because the flowing text builder does not receive the selected-verse set.
fix: Pass selectedVerses into FlowingVerseRun and apply a primaryContainer background span to selected ranges.

claim: The verse card offers only a back-a-day button with no return to today and no indication of which day is shown.
fix: Add a forward button hidden at today, a relative-day label, and hold dayIndex in rememberSaveable.

claim: Reading versus Study mode is in-memory only, so every cold start opens in Reading mode.
fix: Persist the mode and the first visible verse in the bible_reader SharedPreferences alongside font size.

claim: Scripture renders twice per verse when a tier is open, with the verse in secondary colour and its copy in primary text colour.
fix: Suppress the duplicate line when the active version is ELIANA and render scripture in onSurface.

claim: Journey duplicates the bottom bar and Home Quick Access, leaving Prayer and Journal with two parents and no home.
fix: Make the third tab the practices tab with Journal, Prayer, history, and progress, and trim Home Quick Access.

claim: Premium and legacy rendering paths coexist, so three dark themes and several screens still use gradients, translucent fills, and shadows the flagship doctrine rejects.
fix: Give every theme PremiumTokens, delete the gradient path, and remove premium-null branches.

claim: The Home study slot tracks only teaching books, and Aliyah or Foundations progress is never recorded, so the flagship studies never surface as continue.
fix: Record last opened study entry in the study reader and prefer the most recent source in the slot.

claim: Go Deeper depends on one Firestore read and fails to a dead end with no retry and no path to the reader.
fix: Add an Open in Bible header action, a retry, and a reader fallback with the verse targeted.

claim: Theme cards preview accent swatches inside the current theme's surface and omit background, so themes look alike.
fix: Paint each card in its own background with a sample verse line and move taglines into ElianaThemeConfig.

claim: The brain icon means Eliana everywhere else but Study mode in the reader toolbar, and the font strip exposes sp units.
fix: Use a Read | Study segmented control and show three letter sizes instead of sp values.
